title: 第25章 我舍不得你走第26章 我也买房了
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
武爷冷笑连连，不屑地看着魏乾坤。
其实魏乾坤这个年龄能达到这样的境界实属不易，若是他没有和陈凡为敌的话，武爷说不定也想夸赞对方几句。
但可惜，魏乾坤这次惹错了人，那武爷就只能将他视为敌人了。
“武世昌，你成名了几十年，现在也不过和我旗鼓相当而已，你有什么可骄傲的？用不了多久，我就会超越你！”
魏乾坤自信满满说道。
“超过我有什么用？你真正想对付的人可是你这辈子都无法企及的存在！
你们这些人记住今天说过的话，我保证你们都不会有好下场的，不信我们走着瞧。”
武爷说完也离开了。
魏乾坤想要追上去，却被魏秋拦住了。
“算了，武世昌实力不俗，他真的想走，我们也未必强留的住，而且他也不重要。”
魏秋沉闷地说道。
这一场本该风光无限的盛会，因为洛千凝的离开潦草收场。
结束后，宾客散去，只剩魏秋和魏乾坤爷孙二人。
魏乾坤喝着闷酒，心情压抑。
“为什么她会选择一个一无是处的劳改犯，也不选择我？千凝肯定是有什么苦衷，或者被控制了！”
魏乾坤猛灌了一口酒说道。
“别被愤怒冲昏了头脑，你好好想想洛千凝是什么人，她怎么可能轻易被人利用？我只能说，那个叫陈凡的确有一手。”
魏秋说道。
“呵呵，他算个什么东西？我一只手就能捏死他！”
魏乾坤不屑地说道。

“爷爷当然相信你的实力，但现在如果你这么做的话，洛千凝一定会恨死你的！”
魏秋说道。
“爷爷，那我现在该怎么办？”
魏乾坤问道。
“我猜他一定还不知道洛千凝的情况，如果告诉他，我想他一定会知难而退的。”
魏秋这么一说，刚才还一筹莫展的魏乾坤瞬间双眼亮了起来。
……
“没想到他们这么过分，早知道就不邀请你来了，我自己也不会来的。”
离开庄园后，洛千凝一脸郁闷。
她专门来参加的魏乾举办的盛会，给足了对方面子，却没想到自己竟然被算计其中。
魏乾坤当着这么多人向洛千凝表白，或许换做别的女人一定会感动不已，但对于洛千凝而言，只会感到无比厌恶。
content_en:
Master Wu sneered again and again and looked at Wei Qiankun with disdain.
In fact, it is not easy for Wei Qiankun to reach such a state at his age. If he had not become an enemy of Chen Fan, Lord Wu might also want to praise him.
But unfortunately, Wei Qiankun offended the wrong person this time, so Lord Wu could only regard him as his enemy.
"Wu Shichang, you have been famous for decades, but now you are just on par with me. What do you have to be proud of? It won't be long before I surpass you!"
Wei Qiankun said confidently.
"What's the use of surpassing me? The person you really want to deal with is an existence that you can't reach in this life!
You people remember what I said today, I guarantee that you will not end up well. If you don’t believe me, we will see. "
Master Wu also left after speaking.
Wei Qiankun wanted to catch up, but was stopped by Wei Qiu.
"Forget it, Wu Shichang is very powerful. If he really wants to leave, we may not be able to force him to stay, and he is not important."
Wei Qiu said dullly.
This event, which should have been a glorious event, ended abruptly because of Luo Qianning's departure.
After it was over, the guests dispersed, leaving only Wei Qiu and Wei Qiankun's grandfather and grandson.
Wei Qiankun drank wine and felt depressed.
"Why would she choose a good-for-nothing reform-through-labor prisoner instead of me? Qian Ning must have some difficulties, or she is being controlled!"
Wei Qiankun took a sip of wine and said.
"Don't be carried away by anger. Think carefully about who Luo Qianning is. How could she be easily taken advantage of? I can only say that Chen Fan is really good at it."
Wei Qiu said.
"Haha, who is he? I can crush him to death with one hand!"
Wei Qiankun said disdainfully.
"Of course grandpa believes in your strength, but if you do this now, Luo Qianning will definitely hate you to death!"
Wei Qiu said.
"Grandpa, what should I do now?"
Wei Qiankun asked.
"I guess he still doesn't know about Luo Qianning's situation. If I tell him, I think he will retreat."
When Wei Qiu said this, Wei Qiankun's eyes lit up instantly as he was helpless just now.
…
"I didn't expect them to go so far. If I had known, I wouldn't have invited you here, and I wouldn't have come myself."
After leaving the manor, Luo Qianning looked depressed.
She specially came to attend the grand party held by Wei Qian and gave him enough face, but she did not expect that she would be plotted.
Wei Qiankun confessed his love to Luo Qianning in front of so many people. Maybe any other woman would be moved, but for Luo Qianning, she would only feel extremely disgusted.
